identity_boundary: Kim Se Un, listed by OFAC as KIM, Se Un with Hangul 김세운 and alternate spelling KIM, Se-u'n, is the Korea Sobaeksu representative described in Treasury's July 2025 action and the Kim Se-Un named in the same-day State Department reward release. Preserve administrative designation separately from State's group statement that Sim Hyon-Sop and six co-conspirators were charged: the cited evidence resolves the administrative designation and group charging statement, while Kim-specific charging instrument, docket, jurisdiction, individualized count, and disposition remain unresolved. Keep reward terms, 2025 and 2026 network allegations, and source-time roles distinct; guilt, present location, account or wallet ownership, and same-named-public-account identity remain unresolved.
